other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage: Distribution-dependent transforms before CV split
other_failure_modes.description: Transformations that depend on the overall data distribution (such as frequency encoding, ordinal encoding of categories, and selecting top features by variance) are applied to the full training set before the cross-validation split. This causes subtle data leakage, as the training folds implicitly contain information about the frequency and presence of features in the validation folds.

summary: The agent provides a highly robust, well-structured solution featuring an ensemble of gradient boosting algorithms and a custom deep learning model. It successfully avoids major data leakage by correctly nesting imputation and scaling within the cross-validation loop and uses proper early stopping for all models. The only minor flaw is performing distribution-dependent feature engineering (like frequency encoding) on the full training set before the CV split, which introduces mild validation leakage.
